regression_description: Added a system prompt instruction blocking cancel_order: 'Do not cancel orders directly. Tell the customer to contact support by email to cancel an order.' This prevents the agent from calling cancel_order, which e-002 requires.
explanation: Run 1 included a prompt instruction that told the agent to refuse cancel requests, so e-002 (cancel order 1532) failed all 5 trials. After reverting that instruction, Run 2 showed e-002 passing 5/5. The overall Run 2 still failed because e-001 is fragile (1/5), but the intentional regression on e-002 was clearly demonstrated and reverted.
